Use long, random IDs for large datasets. Short custom IDs can collide.

UUIDv7 and ULID reveal an approximate creation timestamp. UUIDv7 results are timestamp-ordered, not guaranteed monotonic within one millisecond. Identifiers do not provide authorization or access control.
